description: List Shop by Aesthetic editorial collections with counts and URLs, plus relatedGuides for finish, texture and palette edits such as matte, pastel, metallic and colour block. Use get_collection for those detailed guides. PAGED (default 6 per page, max 200): returns total, returned, offset, hasMore and nextOffset — call again with offset=nextOffset for the next page.

offset.description: Skip the first N entries (default 0) — use nextOffset from the previous page

name: get_aesthetics
